recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Create **Tetromino Relay Matrix**, a mobile-first portrait browser game that preserves a four-color dice/token race loop while presenting it as a Tetris-inspired geometric matrix challenge.

Primary prompt: Tetris falling-block puzzle. A Tetris falling-block puzzle game with elegant spatial logic, escalating speed, perfect-fit satisfaction, minimalist tension, endless optimization, and iconic geometric rhythm with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

The player commands colored tetromino squads. They tap Start Matrix, roll a placement cube, launch pieces only on six, tap valid squad tokens, capture rival fragments on unsafe shared cells, gain an extra turn on six, and win by docking all four squad tokens exactly into the perfect-fit core. Use dark grid ambience, glowing block marks, crisp HUD text, and reachable portrait controls.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: Four-player dice-and-token race board game rendered on a 15x15 canvas.
- objective: Move all four tokens for one color from base, around the shared track, into that color's home path, and exactly to final state 56.
- input model: Mobile-safe tap/click start, tap/click dice roll, then tap/click a valid token on the canvas.
- core loop: Active color rolls 1-6, launches only on six, moves exact spaces, captures opposing tokens on non-safe shared cells, receives another turn on six, otherwise advances turn.
- fail/friction state: No valid move after a roll automatically passes turn after a short delay; invalid token taps play blocked feedback; terminal state is a completed-color victory overlay.

## Protected mechanics
- Preserve dice values, launch-on-six rule, extra turn on six, exact overshoot prevention above 56, capture rules, safe-zone immunity, token coordinates, turn order, win condition, restart reset, and canvas token hit testing.
- Preserve the single-screen loop and mobile tap/click actionability.
- Do not convert mechanics into actual falling-block gravity because the source has no falling-piece collision or line-clear system and stage safety requires mechanic truth.

## Remixed target
Tetris falling-block puzzle. A Tetris falling-block puzzle game with elegant spatial logic, escalating speed, perfect-fit satisfaction, minimalist tension, endless optimization, and iconic geometric rhythm with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

The target public surface is **Tetromino Relay Matrix**: the original protected race loop is presented as four falling-block squads routing around a precision matrix. The dice is reframed as a placement cube, bases become spawn bays, captures become line-clear pulses, and home paths become perfect-fit docks. The final game uses procedural grid, block, glow, and matrix motifs for a Tetris-inspired mobile portrait experience while preserving source mechanics.
